name: Keep An Eye Out
summary: In Booty Bay, the old sea dog Dizzy One-Eye lost his sight in battle and sees only through a special enchanted glass eye. Bloodsail Buccaneers ambushed him last night and took it, and Dizzy asks for help getting the eye back.

sections.title: The Enchanted Eye
sections.body: Dizzy One-Eye lost both eyes in battle. By good fortune, Dizzy's ship docked at Menethil, where a traveling wizard made a special enchanted glass eye that gave Dizzy sight again. Without it, Dizzy feels useless, and recalls that the crow's nest was once home.

sections.title: Taken by the Buccaneers
sections.body: Last night, Bloodsail Buccaneers ambushed Dizzy on the way out and took the eye. It seems the Bloodsails have made their way into Booty Bay. Dizzy fears the captain will keelhaul Dizzy once the eye's fate comes out, and reckons a lookout who cannot see might only be fit for scrubbing the bilge. So Dizzy asks for help getting the eye back from the Bloodsail Buccaneers.

aliases: who gives keep an eye out
faq.answer: Dizzy One-Eye is an old sea dog in Booty Bay who worked as a lookout. Dizzy lost both eyes in battle and sees only through an enchanted glass eye.

faq.q: Where did Dizzy get the magical eye?
aliases: how did dizzy get his eye
faq.answer: Dizzy's ship put in at Menethil, where a wizard passing through made a special enchanted glass eye that let Dizzy see again.
Bloodsail Buccaneers ambushed Dizzy last night on the way out and took the eye.

faq.q: What does Dizzy fear will happen without the eye?
aliases: what happens if dizzy loses eye
faq.answer: Dizzy fears the captain will keelhaul Dizzy for it, and reckons a lookout who cannot see might only be fit for scrubbing the bilge.
